name: Link Catcher
summary: Turns web addresses in chat into links you can click and copy, and lets you copy whole chat lines as plain text.
logoPrompt: A small butterfly net made of wood and gold mesh, holding a glowing blue chain link inside it

cover.tagline: Copy web links straight from chat.

description: **Link Catcher makes the web addresses other players post in chat clickable, so you can copy a guide or an invite without typing it out.**
- Web addresses in chat turn into blue links: full addresses, ones starting with www. and short ones without it.
- A click opens a small box with the address already selected, ready to copy.
- Copy the last lines of your main chat window as plain text, without colours or icons.
- Item links, colours and numbers like 1.5 in a message stay as they are.

Click a blue link in chat, press Ctrl+C (Cmd+C on a Mac) and paste it in your browser. Type `/lc copy` to copy chat, `/lc copy 50` for fewer lines. `/lc off` and `/lc on` switch the links, `/lc` lists all commands.
- Works on Retail. It works in say, whispers, party, raid, guild, channels and Battle.net whispers.
- Messages the game keeps hidden inside instances are left untouched.
- It never opens a browser by itself; you copy and paste.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
